comparator_intervals.definition: per dataset and comparator, native_arrowflow_knn minus the comparator accuracy, fitting seeds averaged within each outer fold; corrected resampled t over the outer folds (evaluation.paired_corrected_interval, q = test_train_ratio = 0.25, 95%, df = outer folds - 1 = 14); two-sided p, unadjusted; paired fold by fold because the folds are identical in both runs; the comparator with the lowest mean outer error is flagged. Rows against a reused comparator are marked as crossing the two runs

comparator_reuse.features: each item's relative position with a missing value for a deleted item, imputed fold-locally by each model (artificial_ranks' feature rule), NOT the completed ranking
comparator_reuse.matched_comparator: numeric_knn_filled, fitted in this family, is the same numeric kNN grid on the completed positions; the analysis states which comparator matches which encoding
comparator_reuse.reason: the encoded run measured the five tuned classical models and the majority class on these datasets on the identical folds with the identical features; refitting them would reproduce the same numbers

competitiveness.definition: holistic.competitiveness on the mean outer errors of native_arrowflow_knn, the five reused tuned classical models and the reused majority class: the best tuned model, the gap, within three points, best-on, ceiling, near-majority and no-learning

complete_metrics.definition: per dataset and native model, each metric's mean, outer-fold SD and within-fold seed SD from the verified summary.json

data_properties.definition: the completion audit and the probe accuracies of data_properties, quoted in the analysis beside the majority class of the same folds

probes.majority_class: nothing: the training majority class (the reference for both probes)
probes.missing_count: the number of items the row omits, and nothing else
probes.missing_items: the identity of the items the row omits (exactly the appended tail), and nothing else

data_properties.rule: per outer fold of the declared splits, predict the majority training class among the training rows sharing the probe key, falling back to the overall training majority for a key absent from the training rows; ties inside a key and in the fallback go to the lowest class label. Deterministic, no seed, no tuning, no model: a property of the data under the folds the family uses
data_properties.status: descriptive data-property measurement of the completion artifact, computed before any outer score of this family exists; it is never a model of the panel and never enters a family

encoded_contrast.also_reported: the same paired contrast of the two untrained controls and of the two input kNN controls, descriptively
encoded_contrast.definition: per dataset, native_arrowflow_knn of this run minus arrowflow_full_knn of the encoded run, accuracy, fitting seeds averaged within each outer fold; corrected resampled t over the outer folds (evaluation.paired_corrected_interval, q = test_train_ratio = 0.25, 95%, df = outer folds - 1 = 14); two-sided p, unadjusted
encoded_contrast.reading: positive means the native path is better, so the projection cost accuracy; negative means the architecture gains nothing from receiving the ranking directly
encoded_contrast.status: descriptive; PAIRED, because the two runs share the datasets, the splits, the outer folds and the fitting seeds; the two arms differ by the encoder alone, so the model differs and the contrast carries no family and no multiplicity adjustment

analysis.interpretation: fixed before any outer score exists: if the native path does not beat the encoded path, the paper reports that the architecture gains nothing from receiving the ranking directly on these data; if it does, the paper reports the projection's cost. Neither outcome is rescued after the fact
analysis.ladder_table: per dataset, mean outer error, outer-fold SD (ddof 1) and mean within-fold seed SD of every rung

main_table.definition: per dataset, mean outer error (the mean over outer folds of the fitting-seed-averaged error), outer-fold SD (ddof 1) and mean within-fold seed SD, from the verified summary.json of this run for the native models and of the encoded run for the reused comparators; every row names its source run

notes.comparators: the five tuned classical models and the majority class are reused from the encoded run, not refitted; numeric_knn_filled is fitted here because its features are the completed positions
notes.completion: native input: each row's observed sequence (artificial_ranks.sequences_from_features, the present items ordered by their relative position) followed by the items the row omits, in ascending item order, so the row is a complete permutation of the V items; the completion is deterministic and reversible (the first m entries are the observed sequence, m the number of present items)
notes.completion_artifact: because the appended tail is sorted, a row's number of missing items and the identity of those items may carry class information by themselves; data_properties measures both, descriptively, under the declared outer folds, so that no later claim rests on an unmeasured artifact
notes.completion_reason: the author's decision of 2026-09-15. The core's partial-input path is not used: an all-sort network takes SortFlowHybridNetwork._forward_propagate_batch, which calls arrowflow.ranking.validate_permutation on every input row and refuses anything but a complete permutation of the layer vocabulary
notes.descriptive_only: ranks8_original (77 rows) is reported descriptively and belongs to no family
notes.encoding: no encoder runs in any native model: encoding_seconds is zero and the completion time is recorded separately as completion_seconds
notes.low_power: each family holds two datasets, so Holm adjusts over two
notes.no_component_ablation: the component ablation of the encoded families is NOT reused: run_knn_ablation builds its variants from the encoder-based MultiViewArrowFlowKNN through bridge.resolve_selected, and its views7 reproduction is defined against an encoded run, so nothing of it applies to a network with no encoder. The untrained control and the input-kNN control, which are the two component rows that carry the reading, are full models of this family instead
notes.not_pooled: the artificial datasets are never pooled into the seventeen-dataset Friedman analysis
notes.views: with no encoder there is no projection diversity: the seven views differ only by their seeds, hence by their initial filters

native_input.artifact: because the appended tail is sorted, a row's number of missing items and the identity of those items may carry class information by themselves; data_properties measures both, descriptively, under the declared outer folds, so that no later claim rests on an unmeasured artifact
native_input.audit: native_artificial.check_completion is run on every dataset at prepare and its record is written into the prepared manifest: every completed row must be a permutation of exactly the V items, dropping the tail must recover the observed sequence exactly, and the tail must be exactly the missing items in ascending order
native_input.lossy: the completion is not injective: a row whose missing items happen to be the largest item IDs in ascending order at the end completes to the same permutation as a row with no deletion. The audit counts these collisions per dataset
native_input.reason: the author's decision of 2026-09-15. The core's partial-input path is not used: an all-sort network takes SortFlowHybridNetwork._forward_propagate_batch, which calls arrowflow.ranking.validate_permutation on every input row and refuses anything but a complete permutation of the layer vocabulary
native_input.rule: native input: each row's observed sequence (artificial_ranks.sequences_from_features, the present items ordered by their relative position) followed by the items the row omits, in ascending item order, so the row is a complete permutation of the V items; the completion is deterministic and reversible (the first m entries are the observed sequence, m the number of present items)
native_input.vocabulary: the layer-0 vocabulary is the V items themselves, named "1".."V"

projection.assumptions: the calibration factors were measured under 16 single-thread workers of the bridge_knn and knn_training production runs and are applied at this family's workers; every native model takes the factor of the encoded-run model with the same job structure, which prices the native networks with an encoder's cost included and is therefore conservative; other families running at the same time add contention the factors do not hold, and inflate the pilot itself
projection.decision: calibrated central simulated makespan at 16 workers of the run jobs plus 0.25 h of stage overhead (prepare, data properties, reporting, analysis)
